title: Resource Pose Schema
description: Telemetry contract for a resource's live spatial position. Pose is transient wire data, not a stored entity, so it has no identity of its own: identity flows through resourceUrn (the resource described) and lastSeq (monotonic per-resource ordering for snapshot, delta and catch-up delivery). Availability, activity and resource type are the resource-status definitions; the point type is voxel-group's.

availability.description: Optional here: a pose-only delta (position changed, status did not) may omit it, meaning unchanged from the last known value.

activity.description: Optional here, with the same delta-omission meaning as availability.

$schema.description: Schema declaration: the URI of the schema this instance follows.

voxelUrn.description: The voxel the resource is in (urn:luhtech:ectropy:voxel:{id}). Optional: a resource between zones or OFFLINE may have no current voxel anchor.

lastSeq.description: Monotonic per-resource sequence number: a client resuming after a gap requests everything with lastSeq greater than its last-received value; a slow client's queue coalesces to the highest lastSeq per resource rather than replaying every intermediate frame.
